focus: mimo-04: Deep-loop stop and convergence, iterations saved

label: 181 archived lineages carry deltas/iter-*.jsonl and their state records hold newInfoRatio, findingsCount and sourceDiversity, so a stop replay needs no new labels and no iteration prose
The gold stop marker is computable from deltas alone as the last iteration adding a first-appearance cited source, filling the measurement digest's named gap for the correct stop point
The baseline to beat is the heuristic's own replayed trade curve (iterations saved at zero first-appearance loss), not the recorded stop, because forced-depth runs stopped where policy said
The only stop idea that changes an operator decision is an evidence-backed suggestion in confirm mode and one report line; auto mode sees nothing until a measured promotion
A Jev novelty second-rater dashboard column is a report number before it is anything else, so it waits for the replay to show disagreements that change a decision
Jev input to the STOP decision is dropped: authority before measurement is unserviceable, and cross-lens agreement with the contrarian lineage's kill criterion makes this a two-lens conclusion
